speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thwaite was on fourteenthly, and I was still in the messenger's half-line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The half-line is empty. I will not fill it tonight to be done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Soap, blue thread, and the kind with the two ends. Two are wrapped. The third is not named.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am well. The nose is clear.
